<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>Exhibit
99.1</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 18pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 14pt">WM
Names Tara Hemmer Chief Operating Officer</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 18pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 18pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 14pt">Rafa
Carrasco Retiring from WM</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 18pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center; color: #7AB800"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt; text-transform: uppercase; vertical-align: baseline"><B>Houston</B></FONT><B>
<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&mdash; May 13, 2026</FONT></B><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">
 &mdash; WM (NYSE: WM) announced that its Board of Directors has appointe</FONT>d Tara Hemmer to the position of Executive Vice President
and Chief Operating Officer (COO), reporting to John Morris, the company&rsquo;s President, who had also been serving as COO.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Hemmer will assume responsibility for the company&rsquo;s
operating platform, in addition to continuing to lead the Sustainability businesses, including Recycling, Renewable Energy, and Advisory
Services.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&quot;Tara is an outstanding leader with a proven
track record of delivering strong results over her 27-year tenure with WM. As I've worked closely with her throughout that time, I have
witnessed firsthand Tara's commitment to enhancing shareholder value and growing the WM business through operational excellence,&quot;
said John Morris, WM&rsquo;s President. &quot;Over the last five years, she has successfully led WM's Sustainability growth strategy &ndash;
expanding our asset network to include the addition of 14 new RNG sites and 37 recycling facilities with state-of-the-art technology.
There is no one more well-prepared than Tara to lead and evolve WM's operations for the future.&quot;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&quot;I'm honored to be named as WM's Chief Operating
Officer and continue to build on the company&rsquo;s reputation as an operational and environmental innovator. I'm looking forward to
accelerating WM's Operations transformation focused on deploying next-generation technology that will advance the modernization of our
operating model &ndash; delivering increased productivity and valuable solutions for our customers while also delivering results for shareholders,&quot;
said Hemmer. &quot;Most importantly, I'm proud to have the opportunity to lead such an exceptional Operations organization, including
our over 47,000 frontline employees.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Hemmer joined WM in 1999 and has progressed through
various leadership roles, including Senior Vice President of Field Operations, Senior Vice President of Operations, Safety and Environmental
Compliance, Vice President of Disposal Operations, Area Vice President for the Greater Mid-Atlantic Area and, most recently, Chief Sustainability
Officer. She graduated from Cornell University with a Bachelor of Science in Civil and Environmental Engineering.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The company also announced that Rafael Carrasco,
WM&rsquo;s Senior Vice President of Enterprise Strategy and President of the WM Healthcare Solutions business, will be retiring from WM
in July. &ldquo;I want to thank Rafa for his 10 years with the company in a range of operational leadership roles,&rdquo; said Jim Fish,
WM CEO. &ldquo;His leadership over the Stericycle business and a successful integration have set the WM medical waste and Shred-it businesses
up with a strong foundation for future growth. We wish Rafa well in his next chapter.&rdquo; With Rafa&rsquo;s retirement, the WM Healthcare
Solutions business will report directly to John Morris.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>about wm</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">WM (<U>WM.com</U>)
is&nbsp;North America's&nbsp;leading provider of comprehensive environmental solutions. Previously known as Waste Management and based
in&nbsp;Houston, Texas, WM is driven by commitments to put people first and achieve success with integrity. The company, through its
subsidiaries, provides collection, recycling and disposal services to millions of residential, commercial, industrial, medical and municipal
customers throughout the&nbsp;U.S.&nbsp;and&nbsp;Canada. With innovative infrastructure and capabilities in recycling, organics and renewable
energy, WM provides environmental solutions to and collaborates with its customers in helping them pursue their sustainability goals.
In&nbsp;North America, WM has the largest disposal network and collection fleet, is the largest recycler and is a leader in beneficial
use of landfill gas, with a growing network of renewable natural gas plants and the most landfill gas-to-electricity plants, as well
as the largest heavy-duty natural gas truck fleet in the industry. WM also provides collection and disposal services of<I>&nbsp;</I>regulated
medical<B>&nbsp;</B>waste and secure information destruction services in the&nbsp;U.S.,&nbsp;Canada&nbsp;and&nbsp;Western Europe. To
learn more about WM and the company's sustainability progress and solutions, visit&nbsp;<U>Sustainability.WM.com</U>.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>
